subject.title: Bug: License incorrectly displayed as MIT-0 instead of MIT

question: Should ClawHub continue its documented platform-wide MIT-0 policy, or support verified standard MIT declarations for published skills and migrate existing affected listings?
rationale: Current main intentionally normalizes published skills to MIT-0, while the open linked PR would establish a materially different license contract across persisted metadata and public surfaces; source evidence cannot decide the legal and product policy.

options.title: Retain the MIT-0 policy
options.body: Keep the current documented platform-wide license policy and close the implementation candidate as an intentional non-bug.

options.title: Support declared MIT licenses
options.body: Approve a distinct MIT path only with a documented authority order, scoped backfill/consent behavior, and compatibility proof for existing API, CLI, and UI consumers.

recommendation.title: Retain the MIT-0 policy
recommendation.body: Keep the current documented platform-wide license policy and close the implementation candidate as an intentional non-bug.

likelyOwner.reason: The current documented MIT-0 policy appears to originate from steipete’s licensing-policy commit.
